one_star_reviews.text:
Our experience at this accommodation was very bad and, above all, left us feeling unsafe.
Upon arrival, we left our suitcases inside the accommodation and went out to explore the city. When we returned, we collected our luggage and realized that some personal belongings were missing: one person was missing money and another, jewelry.
We consider this a very serious situation and believe it's important to share it so that other guests are aware of it before booking. We can't say for sure who was responsible for the disappearance of our belongings, but the fact is that we entered the accommodation with them and, upon returning, they were gone.
Furthermore, we have contacted them on several occasions to try to clarify what happened, but they haven't resolved anything. They keep giving us the runaround and telling us repeatedly to check our belongings, which we have already done, and they still haven't turned up.
For this reason, our experience was very negative, and we didn't feel safe during our stay.

one_star_reviews.text:
VERY BAD EXPERIENCE. I DO NOT RECOMMEND IT.

After trusting this business on several occasions, my experience has been absolutely disappointing.

In June, I placed an order, and when I finally received it, they sent me a different fabric than the one I had selected and paid for. Furthermore, the garment was too short, had countless buttonholes, and many loose threads. The order also arrived late.

The worst part is that I've been waiting since June for them to resolve the issue and issue a refund, and to this day, I still haven't received my money. I've had to file a complaint, and despite the time that has passed, I still haven't received a solution.

But this wasn't the only time. I previously placed another order a month in advance for my daughter's birthday, precisely to have it on time. The order never arrived. First, they told me they had supposedly shipped it, but I never received any notification or the package. Later, they told me they had sent it to someone else.

I find this to be a complete lack of professionalism and responsibility towards the customer. When a company makes a mistake, the least you expect is for them to take responsibility, explain what happened, and resolve the issue quickly. In my case, none of that happened.

I trusted them, I was patient, and I waited for months, but patience has its limits. To this day, I'm still waiting for my refund from June.

I won't buy from them again, and based on my experience, I can't recommend Telas y Retales. I hope my experience serves as a warning to others about what can happen if they have a problem with an order.

one_star_reviews.text:
A very disappointing experience.

We were a group of 10 (6 adults and 4 children) who stayed for just four nights and encountered numerous maintenance, cleaning, and equipment problems in both apartments: broken patio chairs, a table with broken hinges, non-functioning lamps, a dishwasher that wouldn't drain, and a lack of kitchenware, among other issues.

One of the drains was completely clogged, and the technician found cigarette butts, glass, and a lot of dirt inside. Two plumbers had to come the next day to finish the repair.

And, to make matters worse, on the third night, around 5:00 a.m., the water heater in one of the apartments broke, causing a leak that reached the apartment below. We had to get up to collect the water, wash towels and sheets, and move our belongings. Food spoiled, and the water reached the microwave, which also had to be replaced.

Although some issues were resolved, it was far too many problems for a stay of only four nights. We lost a considerable amount of our vacation time dealing with breakdowns and repairs that should have been resolved before our arrival.

The agency's service was also inadequate: we felt a lack of empathy and a truly effective solution to a situation affecting 10 people.

Given everything that happened, we submitted two official complaint forms, formally documenting the issues and our dissatisfaction.

For the price we paid, we expected a completely different experience and conditions. We would not return and would not recommend this service.

The result is the opposite of what I wanted: the conchae are now excessively close to my head—the left more than the right—while the antihelix continues to protrude. Furthermore, the procedure caused a narrowing of the entrance to my ear canals, to the point that headphones no longer fit properly. I am very unhappy with the aesthetic and functional consequences, and with the lack of communication.

one_star_reviews.text:
Don't get surgery here!

I'm writing this review from a different email address because, knowing how they treat people, I'm afraid of their reaction. But I think it's important for others to know what happened to me before making the same decision.

I had breast augmentation surgery at this clinic, and I wish I'd never done it. After the initial consultation, I decided to have the surgery, and from that moment on, I never felt comfortable or well cared for. The post-operative follow-up was inadequate, and I always felt uncomfortable and awful.

The result was disastrous.

- Obvious asymmetry between my breasts.

- Enormous scars, and they're much higher than they should be: they almost reach the top of my cleavage. It's surreal.

- Nipples that are too small.

They ruined my breasts and, frankly, two years of my life. They've left me with a huge complex. I had to have surgery again at another clinic and pay around €8,000 more to try to fix what they did here. The second surgeon couldn't believe the work they had done on me.

Reading other reviews, I see I'm not the only one with a bad experience. Please do your research and get other opinions before putting yourselves in their hands. It's your health and your body.

They're lucky I'm only writing one review because I have photos and more than enough evidence to file a malpractice lawsuit.

one_star_reviews.text:
This is all that remains of the vast estate of "Lagartijo," the bullfighter who had the people of Córdoba paying them to build a wall around his property, only to pay them again to tear it down and rebuild it.

The easiest way to reach it is from the rusty gate in the lower Campiñuela neighborhood, but it's not very warm there.

One hundred years after his death, in 2000, it was in perfect condition, owned by a family with a cattle business, like several others in the area.

It fell into ruin, and nobody cared, not even the urban planning department, which was supposed to protect heritage sites, but allowed it to crumble and be looted by homeless people. Now, only ruins remain.

A visible disgrace from the road towards Rabanales.

one_star_reviews.text:
Our experience in this apartment was quite disappointing, especially considering the price we paid: over €1,000 for a week.

During our stay, the temperature in the apartment exceeded 27°C both day and night, and the only cooling system available was fans, which were clearly insufficient. This was especially uncomfortable traveling with a one-year-old baby. We understand that air conditioning wasn't advertised, but we felt that, given the price of the stay and the typical summer temperatures in the area, the comfort levels were very poor.

We also encountered some details that we considered neglected. One of the beds didn't have sheets, despite having paid for the entire apartment, and when we requested beach towels and a parasol, we were informed that they weren't included, so we had to buy our own. The stairs leading to the apartment were also quite awkward, and we found no prior information warning us about this.

What disappointed us most, however, was the subsequent handling of our complaint. After informing the owner about the temperature issue, we agreed on a €150 refund as compensation for the inconvenience. This refund has not yet been processed because, we were told, a fee was deducted for making a new copy of the keys.

On this last point, we want to clarify that we mistakenly took the keys with us when checking out. Upon realizing this, once we were already at the airport, we immediately notified the check-in/check-out staff and offered them a solution for retrieving the keys. They ultimately told us they didn't have time to collect them. Therefore, we were surprised that the cost of making a new copy of the keys was then used to cancel the €150 refund that had previously been confirmed.

In short, we felt the value for money was inadequate and that the handling of our complaint also fell short of our expectations. We wouldn't repeat the experience.

one_star_reviews.text:
I placed an order almost 15 days ago. Since it was a sale or promotional period, it said delivery might take longer. After 5 to 8 days, I called to check on its status, and they confirmed I would receive the package by the end of that week.
Today, with the deadline long passed, and after calling more than 10 times and messaging them privately a couple of times, they finally deigned to tell me that I might not receive my order because it was out of stock. This was all after I repeatedly told them to let me know if they thought it wasn't going to arrive so I could cancel it.
So, after all these days, I had no choice but to cancel the order, otherwise they would have processed it later, and I would have wasted my time. I find their work and organization appalling. I will never buy from Scalpers again; it felt like I was buying from AliExpress.

one_star_reviews.text: This week, we went to this pharmacy in the morning because we were covered in bites, possibly from mosquitoes, the previous afternoon. We were later told there was an infestation in the area. After asking the person who served us for the most effective remedy they had because we were having a very strong reaction, they didn't seem particularly interested and sold us a small tube of antihistamine gel for over €10, which would undoubtedly solve the problem. That same afternoon, after three applications, which the pharmacist said was the maximum we could use in a day, we returned because the reaction had worsened significantly. This time, the person who served us tried to sell us a different antihistamine for €12, which, again, was supposedly the best they had. We told them that spending over €22 wasn't guaranteeing any improvement, and they just shrugged. Of course, we didn't buy it. We ended up in the emergency room that same night.

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience was quite negative, especially due to the way I witnessed the staff being treated. I feel it's important to document this because it wasn't an isolated incident, but rather an attitude that was repeated several times during service.

The person in charge of clearing tables constantly addressed the kitchen staff and other employees in a derogatory and humiliating manner. Among other things, she said things to the cook like, "You're not going to get a tip; you all work so I can get paid," and "You can't tell the difference between a rag and a dishcloth." She also told someone who didn't speak Spanish, "Hurry up, you're going to miss your train," a completely inappropriate and particularly offensive comment given the situation.

What was most concerning was the consistency of this behavior: disrespect, derogatory comments, and a way of speaking to colleagues that was very uncomfortable to witness as a customer.

It's one thing to have moments of tension or disagreements at work, but quite another to constantly humiliate or mistreat colleagues in front of customers. Personally, this behavior made the experience very unpleasant and makes me seriously question how the staff is treated at this establishment.

I don't recommend this place and certainly wouldn't return. Customer service shouldn't be limited to how the customer is treated; how the people who work there are treated also says a lot about an establishment.

one_star_reviews.text:
Holiday completely ruined by constant noise and poor service!

Do not book this accommodation if you are looking for peace and comfort. Our experience was simply miserable. For months, day in and day out, we were driven crazy by the construction noise from two adjacent neighbors. You pay a lot of money for a nice holiday, but you get an active construction site in return. And the owners leave you to deal with it.

Moreover, this is absolutely not a quiet place. The main road is clearly audible day and night. Additionally, the house is extremely thin; you can hear the nearest neighbor doing absolutely everything. From flushing the toilet and showering to coughing and talking on the phone, you hear everything. There is no privacy or peace.

The owner's response only made matters worse. Because this involves a private landlord, he abuses his position to evade any form of responsibility. He hides behind cheap excuses such as "this is beyond our control" and "it is stated in the rental agreement." During the entire period, we were not asked once in a decent manner how we were doing. Zero empathy, zero service, and zero customer friendliness.

On top of that, the furnishing of the house left a lot to be desired:

• Poor bedding: Pillowcases that were too small and two separate duvets on a double bed.

• Shabby roof terrace: The sun terrace upstairs is uninviting and not at all furnished for comfortable sitting.
• Mediocre kitchen: The crockery is very cheap and there isn't even enough available.
This stay was absolutely not worth the effort or the money. Unprofessional, and 1 star is still too much.

UPDATE following owner's response: It is recognizable that everything is denied here as well. We had indeed found a house but stayed in this rental property. Including all those months, this meant terrible construction noise. The owners offered the only 'solution' to rent out the month of May to others. They failed in that too; their only commercial channel for this is Facebook. Any conversation about solutions, whatever they might be, was focused solely on "it is what it is, we can't do anything about it, etc." The accusation "that we wanted to get out of the rental contract" is unfounded. The only reason to leave was the ABSURD CONSTRUCTION NOISE. And €9,000 was paid for that; a big discount? In this case, we really did pay top dollar for a place where you can't be. I can understand that others gave a better review, but then there wouldn't have been construction noise for months.... No one really wants that, and indeed, it can happen, but for months?

We never asked them to enter our house independently, and when they did, the dog defended the house. They thought that was justified, by the way... But normally, the landlord is not supposed to enter the rented house when the tenant is not home. And that definitely happened multiple times!

Several cockroaches were found in the house. We deliberately left the last one there for the handover. They removed it from the kitchen counter themselves and said nothing...

The building itself is nice and attractive, but once inside, the low quality of all the furnishings is immediately apparent.

It is advertised as accommodating up to four people, but the sofa bed has a very thin mattress and would only be suitable for very young children.

The apartment is attractive, but it's clear that it has been furnished with low-quality furniture to maximize profit.

There were dogs in the apartment next door that barked incessantly some nights, making it difficult to sleep.

In short, the value for money is very poor; I would not recommend it at the advertised price.

one_star_reviews.text: As one of the reviews rightly points out, my experience at this center leaves much to be desired. I had a breast reduction and a breast asymmetry correction. The reduction was very good, but the asymmetry remained unchanged: one breast larger than the other, one nipple round and the other oval. The lack of follow-up after the surgery was disastrous. All I had to do was send photos of the drains via WhatsApp, and he would check on them without even asking how I was feeling. Later, they touched up the scars, after paying extra, of course, and they don't explain this to you beforehand. They tell you that a touch-up might be necessary, but they don't tell you that you have to pay again. Not to mention the wait times for follow-up appointments—up to an hour and a half or more. I am completely dissatisfied with the result, and I absolutely do not recommend this aesthetic center. The surgeon's lack of empathy and arrogance in explaining things makes him assume you know everything. I recommend this man take a course in interpersonal relations and customer service.

one_star_reviews.text:
I entered the shop with my two daughters, aged four and ten. They were checking a toy. The eldest daughter removed a sticker from the toy to demonstrate its workings to her younger sister. She then placed it back the toy with  the sticker . Suddenly, a seller approached her rudely, demanding payment and accusing her of miss using the toys . I was just three steps  away, getting some sunscreen, and returned to pay when I found my daughter crying.

Firstly, let’s consider the context. This is a shop in the airport where children come to see, and maybe if something gets their attention to buy  a  toy. She didn’t break anything; she didn’t remove it from a package, she did not brake it and she wasn’t alone for more than five minutes. Couldn’t the seller have waited a moment and approached me to explain what was happening? Instead, it was easier to come and make a child cry and accuse me of not educating my daughter properly. Seriously?  Please lady  change jobs because we’re customers with children in the airport’s kids’ section, and they didn’t exhibit inappropriate behaviour.

Please avoid coming to the duty-free shop, El Merecido. Give your money to someone else.

To the lady who intervened and said nothing happened:

Yes, nothing happened. I agree that nothing happened that I couldn’t have apologised for, paid for the toy, or adhered to the shop’s policy. But why did it happen? What happened is a bad experience and unnecessary use of power from an adult to a children…

To the male manager or colleague that talked to my daughter and tried to calm her …. thanks for your attention to us and kindness….

one_star_reviews.text:
Everything I'm about to say is true, and here's how it works:

I had a colovaginoplasty with them. Of course, it was a public tender with the Andalusian Health Service (SAS), and the treatment of those of us who had it done through the public healthcare system is appalling. They have a phone number and email address specifically for people who haven't paid €20,000 for this type of surgery. I had my colovaginoplasty on May 8th at the Vithas Xanit Hospital in Benalmádena, where IM GENDER was the team in charge of these surgeries. The treatment of those of us who had this type of surgery by the clinic has been degrading. You write to their corporate WhatsApp number and they answer you in a week, 10 days, or sometimes not at all. Women like me are left unprotected. In my case, there are noticeable asymmetries even though 80% of the swelling has gone down, if not all of it. Another important point is that the appointments with the doctor are video calls with a person. The call (DR-ALEMAN) or that's his ID in the video calls, video calls of course where you can't feel or touch anything necessary to check that everything is correct since he doesn't even ask you to show him the area. Video calls for 3, 6, and 12 months, and if you really want them to examine you properly, you have to beg them. I suppose you don't receive the same treatment when you pay 20,000 or 25,000 for this surgery as when you go through the public system and it's free. After several attempts to get proper care for myself and all the other women who have had the same surgery, my only option now is to file a complaint.

A truly unpleasant experience. We were waiting to buy a magazine, and instead of serving us with even a modicum of courtesy, the owner spoke to the other customers in a very rude manner.

Even though we had been waiting for a while, she told us quite rudely that, despite our presence, the magazine was reserved and we wouldn't be getting it. After this experience, I certainly have no intention of returning. When we went to other stationery stores, we confirmed with other customers that, although she had received only 13 magazines, she didn't have that many on the waiting list, but rather 28 or more, as she had told other customers. It was a complete rip-off.

A rather disappointing experience. I arrived at 8:00 AM to buy the magazine and, after waiting an hour, was informed that all copies were reserved for a pre-arranged list of 14 people.

I understand that reservations can exist, but they should be transparent and clearly explained. It doesn't seem fair that those of us who arrive early to buy it have to wait only to discover that there are no copies available. There was also a woman on the list who indicated that she wasn't included in the quota of magazines she received. Very opaque.

Furthermore, they don't have their opening hours displayed on the door, as they opened at 9:00 AM, while their website states they open at 9:30 AM.

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience with this construction work has been quite negative. Since approximately November/January, the work has been underway in my apartment, and for months my balcony has lacked adequate protection. The windows were finally installed months later, but they were left unsealed and unfinished.
I reported this problem on several occasions and was repeatedly told that someone would come to fix it. I was even specifically told that they would come to seal them on Friday, and later that it would be around 2:00 PM, but no one showed up, and I received no explanation.
When I tried to get the contact information for the person in charge of the construction to resolve the problem directly, they refused to provide it. Furthermore, the way one of the workers treated me was, in my opinion, completely inappropriate. He even shouted at me and responded sarcastically when I was trying to find a solution.
I understand that construction work can have unforeseen issues, but the least they can do is inform the neighbors, keep to scheduled appointments, and address any reported problems. To this day, I'm still waiting for the work to be completed properly and for someone responsible to contact me.

Regarding the dogs, I would completely separate the two issues. If your dogs urinate in the street, obviously you should pick up/clean up as needed to avoid inconveniencing others. But one thing doesn't justify or solve the other: if there's a problem with the window sealing that's allowing liquids to leak outside, that needs to be checked separately.

In fact, if they're now complaining about the dogs, make sure to document that as well. You could say: "I'm taking steps to avoid inconveniencing others, but I've been requesting that the window be properly sealed since July, and it still hasn't been fixed."

And something important: I wouldn't write in the review that "the company is a scam," "they're incompetent," or anything similar. It's much better to describe exactly what happened. That way, your opinion is much harder to challenge because you're talking about concrete facts.

If you'd like, we can also create a shorter, more concise version for Google, which tends to work better than a lengthy complaint. I also find the lack of transparency regarding providing me with a responsible contact particularly concerning. When I requested the phone number of their manager so I could directly address the issue and seek a solution, I was told they couldn't provide it. When I then asked for the company name so I could investigate and contact them myself, the employee replied that they didn't know the name of the company they worked for.
Frankly, I find such a response difficult to understand and made me feel like I wasn't being taken seriously. If someone works for a company, I think it's reasonable that they would know its name and that there would be an official way to contact the company or the person in charge of the project.
Instead of providing me with a way to resolve the problem, I felt like I was being given the runaround and that a situation that is important to me was being treated as a joke.

one_star_reviews.text:
A terrible experience.

This dealership sent me an offer for the B05 Promax for €22,077 (including the Auto+ Plan) through Carwow. However, their salesman (José García) called me and offered me €24,500 (including the Auto+ Plan and CAE).

He even had the nerve to tell me his offer was better than the one sent through Carwow.
It's clear that José García doesn't understand math, and you shouldn't buy cars from them.

We ordered a Leapmotor B05 through salesman Luis Barrios at the Madrid Electric Vehicle Fair. We paid a €150 deposit, signed the order, and initially, everything seemed fine.
When we made the reservation, we were told that if we saw the car and weren't interested, the deposit would be refunded. We were also informed that we would receive the vehicle in September, so we sold our current car based on that timeframe.
Last Tuesday, we contacted Luis Barrios, and he told us there had been a problem with our order. He didn't know exactly what had happened and said that, instead of September, the car might arrive in December or even January. Obviously, we can't wait that long given the terms of the purchase.

We immediately requested a refund of the €150, and to this day, we still haven't received it. What we find particularly unprofessional is that they were incredibly quick to make the reservation and receive the payment, but when it comes to refunds, the process doesn't seem to have the same urgency.

A very disappointing experience. We expected professionalism, transparency, and adherence to agreed-upon deadlines. For us, the service we've received so far leaves much to be desired.

The purchase process went smoothly (Leapmotor B05), and in that respect, I have no complaints. The problem starts the moment they deliver the car.

From then on, any interaction becomes a nightmare: managing assistance programs, software issues, incidents, inquiries, or any other matter you need resolved. The lack of organization, follow-up, and responsiveness is infuriating.

Honestly, I've never seen such incompetent service in my life. Every problem seems to escalate into another, and what should be a simple process ends up involving calls, waiting, repeated explanations, and constantly having to chase them down to get someone to do their job.

It's a real shame because the purchase experience itself was good, but the customer service and support after delivery leave much to be desired. Buying the car is one thing; getting any issues resolved afterward is quite another.

I hope they seriously improve the management and, above all, the follow-up of incidents, because currently the customer experience is frankly deplorable.

After nine laser hair removal sessions on my arms, and two months after the last session, it's clear it hasn't worked at all. Honestly, I don't think the problem is the laser itself, but rather the technician at the clinic. Based on the experiences of friends and family, which are quite different from mine, as are their results, this technician is a complete hack, rushing through everything and leaving huge gaps instead of working slowly and thoroughly, covering each area properly.
Overall, I've barely lost any hair, but I must specifically mention my shoulders, where I had practically no hair. Since you have to shave with a razor beforehand, the follicles are stimulated. I ended up with much more hair in that area than when I started, because the technician was just giving it two quick passes that didn't even clear the inflamed follicles.

On the other hand, the employee is completely unprofessional. On one occasion, knowing I don't live in Badajoz, she canceled my appointment less than an hour before it was due, and obviously, I was already in the city. Far from offering a solution, she rescheduled me for a month later, even though she had canceled it herself. To make matters worse, I had a tattoo on my arm that needed to be done sooner, with a two-week gap between the two appointments. I ended up having to reschedule my appointment with the tattoo artist, which meant losing my deposit. Then, at the rescheduled appointment, she rushed me even more, leaving a terrible result and barely removing any hair follicles.

I've attached photos of the results after nine sessions. It's been two months since the last session, and I have to trim my arm hair (with an electric razor that doesn't promote hair growth) every week. The last time was four days ago.

In conclusion, I would recommend any other laser clinic in Badajoz or even in Spain, because the service is terrible and the result is a complete waste of money. Best regards.

one_star_reviews.text: It's appalling. They mark you as absent, leave the package at the Santa Cruz collection point, and that's it. In my case, it was a lie that I was absent, but the delivery driver didn't even call to arrange the delivery. These people have absolutely no ethics. I live in Garafía, and I contract and pay Seur to deliver to my home. Tell me now how and when, with work and children, I'm supposed to be able to go to Santa Cruz? Tell me who's going to pay for the gas for the round trip when I've already paid them to deliver that package to my house. How does Seur prove I was absent? There's no way to justify these people. Never again.

My experience at this store was very unpleasant. Today, Thursday, September 17th, in the afternoon, I went with my daughter, and while she was looking at the products, she picked up a bottle to examine it. I completely understand that products shouldn't be handled carelessly, but the sales assistant's reaction seemed totally disproportionate: she snatched the bottle from her hands roughly, instead of calmly explaining that she shouldn't touch it.

I find this behavior especially surprising in a store clearly geared towards children. Precisely for this reason, I believe there should be a minimum of patience, courtesy, and consideration when speaking to children.

You can teach a child that something shouldn't be touched without treating them that way. As a parent, I found it very upsetting to see how she spoke to my daughter, and I left the store feeling disappointed.

I hope you review how you treat children and families, because the treatment we received left much to be desired.

one_star_reviews.text:
Paying for everything and receiving zero value: A completely disappointing experience.

I perfectly understand charging admission to a private event and that anything inside (food, clothing, jewelry) is extra. The space is pleasant for a drink at sunset, but the real problem arises when even the simplest children's entertainment (bouncy castles, pottery workshop, painting) costs an additional €5 per activity.

The worst part isn't just the extra cost, but the complete lack of information and management:
Misinformation at the ticket office: We specifically asked before paying for admission to avoid this situation, and the person at the ticket office assured us that the activities weren't charged separately. The reality upon entering? Surprise: they were all extra.

Lack of transparency: Neither the exterior signs nor their channels inform us of these extra costs.

Poor customer service: When we complained, the staff's response was simply to hide behind the excuse that "since it's a private event, they do what they want."

Paying for a general admission ticket only to find that the event offers absolutely nothing included for families makes no sense. A "anything goes" place with a very poor selection. I absolutely do not recommend it.

one_star_reviews.text:
I joined this club hoping to do some outdoor sports and meet people, but instead I found myself facing two distinct groups that would make Game of Thrones look like a movie.

On one side, the "Elite," the "competition" team (though they rarely, if ever, win any significant prizes), constantly struggling to secure resources from the meager membership fees. They're always looking for a trailer for their racing boat, better equipment, while the "recreational" boats languish like a beached whale, their oars splintering or deteriorating with each passing day.

On the other side, there are the recreational boats, mostly made up of friendly old folks who think they're the best rowers in the world. Here you'll hear shouts like "look at the person in front!" or "stretch your back more!" while they seem to be wearing (or maybe they are, who knows?) an orthopedic corset that prevents them from moving without looking like a broken robot (by the way, they don't handle keeping up with the person in front very well either...it's just that old age thing...).

On these boat trips, there are other characters, like those endearing ladies who never stop giving unsolicited advice while reminding you that they were champions of...I'm not quite sure what. (I don't remember exactly, but maybe it was crochet). Of course, all of this is done from the bow of the boat, where they can yell at everyone while meticulously analyzing every mistake like a gossipy old woman.

In short, you'll find an association that helps our elders continue to feel more than important, or, if you prefer, a team that wants to win something but...is struggling.

What you won't find is a good atmosphere or young people, although there aren't many middle-aged people.

The best part is that you can pay every 6 months, so you can cancel quickly after enjoying the experience.

Customer Service Review

My experience with the sales assistant Carolina was quite negative. I feel her customer service and her comments about other supermarkets leave much to be desired. I was particularly struck by her disparaging remarks about cashiers at other stores, giving the impression of some rivalry or envy towards them.

I also find it very unprofessional that she spends her time speaking ill of other supermarkets and stores, such as Consum, instead of focusing on providing good service and representing Eroski appropriately.

I believe that someone who works in customer service should maintain a respectful attitude towards customers, other employees, and staff from other establishments. I hope Eroski takes this type of behavior into account, because these kinds of comments create a very negative impression of the service received.

However, they haven't met the deadline they gave me, and to make matters worse, they're now telling me the results will be available several business days after the date they had assured me.

If you have an urgent need, don't trust the deadlines they give you, because in my case, they weren't met. They charge for the service, but I believe they should also honor the information they provide to the client.

A disappointment, especially when you choose a clinic precisely because they assure you that you'll have the results on time.

A pathetic, ludicrous parcel delivery service.
The delivery driver called me saying he had a package to deliver. I asked if it was already at my door, and he said yes. I went outside, and no one was there. I told him it wasn't true that it was at my door, that maybe it was somewhere else by mistake. He insisted it was at my door. I asked him to describe the door, which he did, but none of the details matched. I told him again that it wasn't true that it was at my door, and he said he was going to return the package.
Simply put, they are a bunch of shameless liars. They didn't deliver the package and returned it, charging me for the service without having done anything. I'm giving them one star because it's not possible to give them zero.

I should really look into the shipping companies I supposedly use, at least the ones that sent me a package that never arrived.

In July, I placed an order that, supposedly due to supplier issues, was delayed. It was shipped, but it never arrived… what bad luck!
After a month of waiting and growing frustration, she apologized, sent the item again, and surprise, surprise! IT STILL DIDN'T ARRIVE. I don't know if the shipping companies are failing, if it's the staff, or what the heck is going on with my orders and/or my address. It's not like I live in Pennsylvania; I live in the South. The South, which has never had any problems receiving packages. No tracking number, nothing. I also don't know if it was never even shipped or what, because she was also going to send me photos of the new item, and I'm still waiting.
To her credit, she refunded my money—of course! And she confidently told me that if the order arrived, I could keep it as compensation for the inconvenience. She was just as certain as I was that she never even sent that item.

Good luck with the business, because you're going to need it if you keep doing things this well. Not recommended at all.

one_star_reviews.text:
⭐ 1 out of 5 stars – Disappointing experience with Metrovacesa at Blue View Heights in Manilva

I would like to warn potential property buyers about the problems I have experienced with Metrovacesa, the developer of the Blue View Heights residential complex in Manilva, Spain.

Our property has moisture problems affecting an exterior wall. Based on our observations, the dampness occurs particularly after rainfall, even though the garden irrigation system has been switched off for a considerable period of time.

This raises serious concerns about the quality of the waterproofing, drainage system, and overall construction work.

From a large and well-established property developer such as Metrovacesa, I expect a professional investigation into the causes, a proper and permanent solution to the defects, and transparent communication.

My warning to potential buyers: Before purchasing a property developed by Metrovacesa, I strongly recommend having the construction quality, waterproofing, drainage systems, and warranty conditions carefully inspected by an independent expert.

Based on my experience so far, I cannot recommend Metrovacesa.

one_star_reviews.text:
A loyal customer lost forever.

I had been a regular Consorcio customer for years. I bought some 65g XL anchovies that were, in my opinion, excessively salty and had quite a few bones, something I absolutely did not expect from a product of this category and price.

I filed a complaint on July 22nd, providing photographs and all the documentation they requested, and I had to follow up several times to get a response.

After more than a month, their conclusion was that the batch was within their quality parameters and that, being a handcrafted product, there could be variations between packages.

A completely disappointing response. Handcrafted production can justify certain differences between pieces, but I don't consider it reasonable to use that argument in response to a complaint about excessive salt and numerous bones.

The worst part was the handling of the matter: more than a month of waiting, several follow-ups on my part, and ultimately no solution, compensation, or even a gesture of goodwill toward a loyal customer.

After this experience, I will never buy Consorcio products again. They've lost a customer forever.

Terrible experience. I can't give them negative stars because it's not possible, but I would give them every negative star I could. Previously known as Descontia SL.
I bought an apartment in Valladolid in 2024, with construction managed by this developer. There was a six-month delay in the sale in my case, but my neighbors experienced delays of up to a year.
At the notary's office, I asked if the driveway access permit had been processed, and they said yes.
When I arrived at the apartment, we found it without electricity meters, water meters, a driveway access permit, heating, temporary construction water and electricity, and no hot water.
After a month of trying to contact them, I finally got through. I explained the situation, and they stalled for a month until they made the apartments habitable (with hot water). As a funny aside, there's an umbrella on the roof to prevent water from leaking into the telecommunications cabinet, and it's still there to this day.
To this day, there are still structural issues to be resolved through legal channels. I do not recommend anyone buy an apartment from these shameless people, who don't care at all about the condition of the apartment they sell you, as long as the money is in their pockets.

one_star_reviews.text:
My family and I have had a very disappointing experience with this church. There are aspects of its operation that I find troubling, and I believe others should be aware of them to form their own opinions.

One of the points I question most is the insistence on how members should manage their finances. They promote tithing 20% ​​of income, which I consider excessive. Each person should be free to manage their own money and decide how much they can contribute based on their financial situation, without feeling pressured or questioned about it. It seems contradictory to me that they place so much emphasis on how others should manage their finances when I believe there should be absolute transparency regarding the administration of the money the congregation receives.

I also have concerns about the level of dedication, collaboration, and financial effort demanded of members when the pastors don't have jobs outside the church. From what I understand, tithes help finance their salaries and expenses, as well as their annual trips to Guatemala. I believe they should clearly explain how the contributions are distributed and how these expenses are justified.

Another particularly disappointing matter directly affects my family: my mother paid €50 for a chair intended for the new temple, and as far as we know, that chair never arrived. We would have liked to receive a clear explanation about what happened and where that money went. It's not just about the amount, but about the responsibility and transparency that should exist when someone contributes money for a specific purpose.

In general, I'm concerned that so much importance is placed on financial contributions and the dedication of members, while issues like these generate doubt and mistrust. I believe that no one should feel obligated to give a significant portion of their income or dedicate a large part of their time to demonstrate their commitment to their faith.

I respect everyone's beliefs and their freedom to practice the religion they choose. Precisely for this reason, I believe there should also be freedom to question certain practices, ask for explanations, and share negative experiences without it becoming a problem.

I share this review based on my own experience and that of my family. Our trust has been affected, and I believe that economic transparency, accountability, and respect for personal decisions should be fundamental in any congregation.

one_star_reviews.text:
Disappointing experience regarding the deposit...

I stayed at Student Experience Granada for 4,5 months, and my rental contract ended on June 30. According to the emails I received from info@studentexperience.com, and as explicitly confirmed in my rental contract, my €1,000 deposit was supposed to be returned one month after my departure.

July 30 came and I received nothing, despite having completed everything required from my side. At the beginning of August, I sent several emails to request an update. Strangely, I received no response, even though they had always replied quite quickly during my stay.

I also tried calling, but I could not get through using my Belgian number, so I had someone call on my behalf. They eventually reached someone who explained that there were apparently issues within the finance department. However, there was no real apology for the delay and, more importantly, I was not given any clear date for when my deposit would actually be returned.

After two weeks of delay, I contacted them again via WhatsApp. Only then did I finally receive an email saying that I would receive my deposit “as soon as possible”. I eventually received the €1,000 on August 21 — 23 days after the date stated in my contract.

I find it unacceptable and frankly shameful that a company does not respect the terms of its own contract, especially when it concerns returning €1,000 to students. Students should not have to repeatedly chase a company to get money that is contractually owed to them. I honestly believe that if I had not insisted so much, I might still be waiting for my deposit.

I want to emphasize that the facilities are nice and the reception staff were genuinely friendly and helpful during my stay. Unfortunately, the way my deposit was handled has left me with a very negative final impression of this residence.

one_star_reviews.text:
⭐️ 1/5 — Extremely disappointed

I deeply regret choosing this surgeon for my breast lift.

The result is extremely disappointing. My breasts are visibly uneven, the nipples/areolas are positioned far too high, and they are clearly visible above many of my bras, tops and dresses. I am also left with noticeable scars and ongoing pain and discomfort.

What makes this situation even worse is the complete lack of accountability afterwards. I have repeatedly tried to contact the surgeon and get answers, but I am often left without a response. When I do receive a response, instead of taking responsibility for the result, she denies that there is anything wrong with her work and blames my breasts and my anatomy.

But this is exactly what I don’t understand: I came to a surgeon because I trusted her to perform the surgery and make the necessary decisions based on my body. If the final result is uneven, the nipples are placed excessively high, and I am unhappy with the outcome, I expect the surgeon to at least take my concerns seriously instead of simply blaming my breasts.

A surgeon cannot take responsibility for performing the procedure when everything goes well and then blame the patient’s body when the patient is unhappy with the result.

This has had a significant impact on my confidence and how comfortable I feel in my own body. I paid for a professional surgical result and expected proper aftercare and communication. Instead, I feel ignored, dismissed and left to deal with the consequences myself.

I would strongly encourage anyone considering surgery here to do extensive research, ask very specific questions about possible complications and, most importantly, find out exactly how the surgeon handles things when a patient is unhappy with the result.

I trusted this surgeon with my body, and unfortunately, I do not feel that my trust was respected.
